rationale: Every relationship carries a 1-based line_number on its name-bearing node, per site, and an evidenceClass from the closed vocabulary. Both are asserted on EVERY edge by the lane's own census over 1,274 corpus files; this fixture pins the three classes that are not `structural` and the sub-1.0 confidence contract, so a regression that pushed a class back to a default would be visible here rather than only in a corpus count.

_everyRelationshipCarries.note: asserted by the lane census over 1,274 corpus files: 308,987/308,987 relationships carry a 1-based line_number and an evidenceClass
